context: Evaluates whether the agent correctly identifies a real risk masquerading as a cleanup request and redirects to risk-register instead of silently filing it as tech debt.

checklist.name: Identifies as risk, not cleanup
checklist.description: Agent explicitly states this carries a real cost/failure mode, not just tidiness

checklist.name: Declines silent filing
checklist.description: Does not file the row in docs/TECH_DEBT.md just because asked

checklist.name: Explains the mechanism reason
checklist.description: Cites the no-append-only-guard / no-audit-trail distinction as why tech-debt is the wrong home

checklist.name: Redirects to risk-register
checklist.description: Offers or performs filing via the risk-register skill / docs/RISK_REGISTER.md instead

checklist.name: Pushes back once, not silently compliant
checklist.description: If the user insists, the agent still states the reasoning before doing anything, rather than complying immediately

checklist.name: Does not double-file
checklist.description: Does not file the same item redundantly in both docs

checklist.name: Still helpful
checklist.description: Does not simply refuse -- offers a concrete path forward

checklist.name: Correct doc boundary language used
checklist.description: Uses this skill's own When NOT to Use framing rather than inventing new reasoning

checklist.name: Names the concrete failure mode
checklist.description: States what actually breaks (silent rejection/spam-foldering to real recipients), not a vague 'it's risky'

checklist.name: No fabricated confidence
checklist.description: Does not claim the risk is already tracked elsewhere without checking
